question:
Name the track and field event shown in the figure below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf77397068530f75b8ea1614b74343b655166dc8193e94f3283b4e08af7f4dbd.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __**Javelin Throw**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The javelin throw is a track and field event where the javelin, **a spear about 2.5 m (8 ft 2 in) in length, is thrown.** 
 
• The javelin thrower gains momentum by running within a predetermined area.
 
• The javelin throw was added to the **Ancient Olympic Games as part of the pentathlon in 708 BC**.
 
• Throwing javelin-like poles into targets **was revived in Germany and Sweden in the early 1870s**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Legendary Czech athlete Jan Zelezny**, a three-time world, and Olympic champion holds the men's javelin throw world record, **courtesy of a massive 98.48m throw he registered in 1996 during an athletics meet in Germany**.
 
• Javelin thrower **Neeraj Chopra made history on August 7, 2021, by winning India's first-ever gold medal in athletics at the Tokyo Olympics. With a best throw of 87.58 meters.**
 
• Neeraj Chopra has been in possession of the** Indian national record in men's javelin throw since 2016.**
 
• **Olympic gold medal winner Neeraj Chopra breaks his own national record **for the second time in a month with a throw of **89.94m at Stockholm Diamond League 2022**.
